name: What accessibility features beyond ramps can improve a back entrance?

mainEntity.name: What accessibility features beyond ramps can improve a back entrance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Beyond ramps, several features can significantly enhance back entrance accessibility. These include widening existing doorways to accommodate wheelchairs or walkers, installing lever-style door handles for easier grip, and adding motion-sensor lighting for improved visibility. Threshold modifications to eliminate tripping hazards, non-slip surfaces on steps or landings, and even automated door openers can also contribute to a safer and more user-friendly entry point.
acceptedAnswer.description: Beyond ramps, other features include wider doorways, lever handles, motion-sensor lighting, threshold modifications, non-slip surfaces, and automated door openers to improve back entrance accessibility.
